documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No documents are visible to you yet.
documents.err_file_required: Choose a file to upload. The file field is cleared after an error, so pick it again.
documents.err_too_large: That file is too large, or it would take your storage over its limit. Choose a smaller file.
documents.err_type_not_allowed: That file type is not allowed for documents. Choose a PDF, Office file, image, text or archive file.
documents.edit_file_hint: Leave blank to keep the current file.
documents.delete_confirm: Delete "{0}"? It disappears for everyone. You can restore it from Deleted documents.
documents.deleted_lede_owner: Documents you deleted. Restoring a document puts it back exactly as it was.
documents.deleted_lede_admin: Documents deleted by their owners. As an administrator you can restore any of them; a restored document goes back under the audience its owner chose.
documents.folder_hint: File this document into a folder to keep the repository organized.
documents.tags_hint: Type to search existing tags, or start a new one.
